description: Alberta’s seasonal influenza summaries contain provincial and health-zone statistics on influenza activity, outbreaks, hospitalisations and immunisation rates, with age-group breakdowns. The concrete healthcare subject is hospitalisation demand; the collection also contains broader disease-surveillance information. Metadata lists eight PDF season reports from 2012–2013 through 2019–2020 and links a separate earlier summary series. Exact within-season observation intervals and hospital-level breakdowns are not stated. The source calls these annual summaries; a specific simulation application is not described. All eight report descriptors remain one data/information resource, and the uninspected earlier linked series is not counted as additional coverage. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue provides descriptive metadata and exact original Alberta distribution identifiers. It labels the collection Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is through the linked descriptive record; current provider access and actual file downloads are untested. Costs are not stated. No document, workbook, archive or dataset body was fetched, and numerical contents have not been independently checked. Related editions and components are grouped only where the source identifies their relationship.
